title: Authorize CRM customer follow-up records with live customer-follow menu authority, ERP-097 customer scope and bounded field validation
description: Stage 3 access-control closure for the CRM customer follow-up records the 客户跟进记录 page maintains. src/ERP.Api/Controllers/CustomerFollowUpController.cs:12-17 declares CustomerFollowUpController with only [ApiController]/[Route(api/crm/follow-ups)]/[Authorize] and no overrides, so every route is inherited unguarded from src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BaseCrudController.cs:37-92 (GetPaged 38-43, GetAll 46-51, GetById 53-59, Create 62-67, Update 69-76, Delete 79-84, BatchDelete 87-92) and delegates to IGenericService (src/ERP.Application/Services/GenericService.cs) with zero identity, menu or customer-scope resolution, so any authenticated account can list, mint, edit or soft-delete every customer's follow-up records. Reuse the existing 客户跟进记录 (customer-follow, src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SchemaUpgrader.cs:621-627) functional menu on every route, reuse the existing ERP-097 salesperson data scope (src/ERP.Application/Services/SalespersonDataScopeService.cs:59 ResolveAsync, CustomerId ownership) for restricted accounts, and add bounded server-side validation for the persisted CustomerFollowUp columns (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/CustomerFollowUp.cs:12-61), keeping the generic BaseCrudController contract and soft-delete semantics unchanged for every other derived controller. No Domain/Infrastructure/schema change, no grant, no anonymous/admin fallback. Genuine isolated (localdb)\\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST SQL only; safe Release build plus full ERP.UnitTests. All entry points including in-process controllers must enforce live authorization. Adapt legacy fixtures by seeding an enabled identity and existing menu grants in the isolated test context; never gate authorization on Request.Path, environment, fake identity, or an empty request to bypass checks.
acceptance_criteria: For every route on /api/crm/follow-ups (paged, all, by-id, create, update, delete and batch delete) require the current enabled nondeleted identity and the existing customer-follow functional menu before any read or write, rejecting missing, disabled, deleted and revoked-menu identities with the existing controlled non-disclosing errors and adding no new grants or anonymous/admin fallback.

Restrict customer follow-up reads to the current ERP-097 salesperson data scope and require that create and update writes name a CustomerId inside that scope, so a denied read or write loads, returns or mutates no CustomerFollowUp row and the soft-delete semantics stay unchanged for every other derived controller.

Validate on create and update that FollowNo is non-empty and within its persisted length bound, that FollowType, ContactPerson, SalesmanName, Subject, CustomerName, Result and Remark stay within their persisted bounds, that Content stays within its persisted bound, and that a non-empty CustomerId and SalesmanId resolve to known nondeleted records, so a rejected write persists no CustomerFollowUp change.

Genuine isolated SQL authenticated controller tests cover the permitted privileged and menu-granted flows, missing customer-follow menu, disabled, deleted and revoked identities, out-of-scope customers and invalid or over-long follow-up payloads, and assert that denied paged, all, by-id, create, update, delete and batch-delete calls read or mutate no CustomerFollowUp row while the existing FollowUpDueScopeTests and CustomerMasterAuthorizationTests contracts stay green.

Keep the safe Release build and the full existing ERP.UnitTests suite green, use only genuine isolated (localdb)\\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST databases with Integrated Security, and add no schema, entity, menu, permission or production/secret change; build completion is not stage acceptance.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Api/Controllers/CustomerFollowUpController.cs:12-17 declares CustomerFollowUpController with only [ApiController]/[Route(api/crm/follow-ups)]/[Authorize] and no overrides, so all routes are inherited unguarded from src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BaseCrudController.cs:37-92 (GetPaged 38-43, GetAll 46-51, GetById 53-59, Create 62-67, Update 69-76, Delete 79-84, BatchDelete 87-92), which call IGenericService (src/ERP.Application/Services/GenericService.cs) with zero Authorize/Menu/scope references. CustomerFollowUp (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/CustomerFollowUp.cs:12-61) persists FollowNo(15-16, Required MaxLength 50), CustomerId(22), SalesmanId(37), Content(47-49, MaxLength 1000) and Remark(58-60, MaxLength 500) with only attribute annotations. The re-used existing menu is seeded at src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SchemaUpgrader.cs:621-627 (customer-follow, crm:customer-follow) and the page is registered at src/ERP.Api/wwwroot/js/modules.js:518-548 (app.js:337 icon map). The required override-with-live-authorization plus ERP-097 scope pattern already exists at src/ERP.Application/Services/CustomerAuthorizationRules.cs:143-177 (EnsureAuthorizedAsync via CustomerReceivableReconciliationService.LoadAuthorizedMenuCodesAsync) and src/ERP.Application/Services/SalespersonDataScopeService.cs:59 (ResolveAsync); the sibling regression contracts are src/ERP.UnitTests/FollowUpDueScopeTests.cs and src/ERP.UnitTests/CustomerMasterAuthorizationTests.cs. There is no CustomerFollowUpAuthorizationRules in src/ERP.Application/Services and an exact search of .ai/tasks returns no task listing CustomerFollowUpController or CustomerFollowUp for live authorization.
